description: This file defines the 'Call' class as part of the SuiteCRM (a SugarCRM fork) module for managing call records. It includes properties for call details, methods for access control, saving, related contact retrieval, notification handling, and list view data formatting.

classes.name: Call
classes.description: Main class representing a Call record in SuiteCRM, encompassing properties for call attributes and methods for lifecycle management, access control, notifications, relationships, and UI data formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Class constructor initializing properties, custom fields, and setting up field mappings.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Controls access to edit, save, or delete the call based on recurring source, sync status, and view type.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides parent save to compute end date based on start date and duration, handle notifications, reminders, and vCal cache.

methods.name: removeUnInvitedFromReminders
methods.description: Filters reminders to remove invitees no longer associated with the call.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves related contacts for the call.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Provides a string summary of the call, typically its name.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Generates SQL for listing calls with filtering, joining contacts and users.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates SQL for exporting call data, optionally including contacts.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields like contact name, default dates, and reminder settings.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares call data formatted for list view UI, including status indication and contact info.

methods.name: create_notification_email
methods.description: Creates an email notification, attaches iCal if configured.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Populates email template with call details and user-specific URLs.

methods.name: get_call_users
methods.description: Retrieves users linked to the call with their requirements and acceptance status.

methods.name: get_invite_calls
methods.description: Fetches calls to which a specific user is invited but has not accepted or responded.

methods.name: set_accept_status
methods.description: Updates the acceptance status for a user or contact related to the call.

methods.name: get_notification_recipients
methods.description: Assembles list of users, contacts, and leads to notify about the call.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates interface support, e.g., ACL compatibility.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Determines visibility and permissions for list views based on ACLs.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Saves related entities, excluding certain IDs based on context.

methods.name: getDefaultStatus
methods.description: Returns default status for new call records based on field definitions.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Handles deletion of call records with recurrence correction.
